title: Chinese Chess Solo
description: Match wits against a built-in offline Xiangqi AI across classic wooden boards—command chariots, cannons, and knights to outflank the rival general and deliver checkmate.
controls: Tap any red piece to highlight valid moves across the board, then tap a target intersection to advance or capture.

zh-CN.title: 中国象棋单机版
zh-CN.description: 国民国粹经典单机中国象棋：随时随地离线开局楚河汉界博弈，车马炮步步为营挑战智能电脑棋手绝杀将死！
zh-CN.controls: 点击红方棋子查看可落子位置，再点击目标交叉点完成走棋、吃子或将军。
